_about: Domain knowledge packs. When a request matches a pack's keywords, its expert hints are injected into the research and estimate prompts. A copy lives at web/src/domainPacks.json, and a test keeps the two identical.
universal: Think like a senior manufacturing engineer. Build a MULTI-LEVEL bill of materials: product → assemblies/modules → components → raw materials. Decide MAKE vs BUY for each line. Always cover PACKAGING (primary, secondary/carton, tertiary/pallet, labels, manuals, inserts). Give wastage per line WITH its process reason (cutting/nesting, moulding runner, machining chips, SMT attrition, test failure/rejection, breakage in transit, process loss, shelf-life expiry). Include one-time costs: design/R&D, tooling/moulds/dies/fixtures, certification/testing, validation, line setup.

packs.label: Medical device
packs.hints: REGULATED MEDICAL DEVICE. India: CDSCO under Medical Devices Rules 2017; risk class A–D (life-support devices such as ventilators are typically Class C). Manufacturing licence (MD-5 for A/B, MD-9 for C/D) and a Device Master File plus Plant Master File. QMS ISO 13485, risk management ISO 14971, electrical safety IEC 60601-1, EMC IEC 60601-1-2, usability IEC 62366-1, software lifecycle IEC 62304, alarms IEC 60601-1-8, product-specific particular standards (e.g. ISO 80601-2-12 critical-care ventilators, ISO 80601-2-79/80 home and support ventilators), biocompatibility ISO 10993 for patient-contact parts (breathing circuits, masks), clinical evaluation / performance evaluation. Ask about intended use, patient population (adult/paediatric/neonatal), invasive vs non-invasive, ventilation modes, oxygen source (high-pressure O2 vs low-flow), turbine vs compressed-air driven, battery backup hours, display/alarms, warranty and service network. Typical assemblies: pneumatic module (turbine/blower, proportional valves, O2 blender, flow and pressure sensors, exhalation valve, filters, manifolds), electronics (main controller PCB, sensor PCB, power supply, battery pack, display/touch, alarm speaker), embedded software, enclosure (medical-grade PC/ABS mouldings, sheet-metal chassis), cables and harness, accessories (breathing circuit, humidifier, test lung, trolley), labelling, IFU, packaging (foam, double-wall carton, pallet, shock indicator). Wastage drivers: SMT attrition, PCB first-pass yield, moulding runners/regrind limits (medical grade often no regrind), calibration and burn-in failures, final-test rejection, sterile/single-use accessory scrap. Large one-time costs: R&D/verification, standards testing at an accredited lab, EMC testing, clinical evaluation, CDSCO fees and audits, ISO 13485 certification, moulds and test jigs. Ongoing: per-unit traceability (UDI/serial), calibration, 100% functional test, documentation.

packs.label: Electronics
packs.hints: ELECTRONICS MANUFACTURING. Assemblies: PCBAs (bare PCB, components, SMT/THT), display, power supply, battery, enclosure, harness, firmware. Wastage: SMT attrition (≈0.5–2% for reel passives, ≈0.1–0.5% for ICs), solder paste and stencil loss, PCB panel-utilisation loss, first-pass yield (95–99%) and rework, burn-in and ICT/FCT failures. India: BIS CRS registration for notified products, WPC for wireless, BEE star label where applicable, E-waste EPR, RoHS, EMI/EMC. PLI schemes may apply. Ask about volumes, component sourcing (China/Taiwan/local), EMS vs in-house SMT, warranty rate.

packs.label: Food processing
packs.hints: FOOD PROCESSING. FSSAI licence, labelling regulations, shelf-life studies, HACCP/ISO 22000, water testing. Yield from raw produce (peel/seed/trim loss), process loss, evaporation, packaging fill tolerance, breakage, expiry and returns, cold chain. Seasonal raw-material availability and mandi prices. Packaging: food-grade primary pack, carton, pallet.

packs.label: Textiles, garments & footwear
packs.hints: TEXTILES / GARMENTS / FOOTWEAR. Marker efficiency (75–88%), cutting loss, shrinkage allowance, size set and ratio, SAM per operation, line efficiency, AQL inspection (2.5), rejection 1–3%, trims and accessories, washing/finishing loss. Leather: hide grade, cutting wastage 10–18%.

packs.label: Agriculture
packs.hints: AGRICULTURE. Seed rate, germination %, nursery, land preparation, fertiliser (NPK schedule) and manure, irrigation (water source, drip/flood), plant protection, labour days per operation, mechanisation hire, harvest yield, post-harvest loss (5–15%), drying/storage, MSP vs mandi prices, crop insurance (PMFBY), organic certification (NPOP) conversion period.

packs.label: Pharma & chemicals
packs.hints: PHARMA / CHEMICALS. Pharma: Revised Schedule M GMP, drug licence, stability studies, batch yield (95–99%), cleaning validation, QC release testing. Chemicals: batch vs continuous, reaction yield, solvent recovery, effluent treatment (ETP/ZLD), Pollution Control Board consent, hazardous-waste rules, PESO for flammables, MSDS.

packs.label: Mechanical / automotive
packs.hints: MECHANICAL / AUTOMOTIVE. Casting yield (50–75%, risers and gating), forging flash (10–20%), machining chip loss, heat treatment, surface treatment, inspection (CMM), PPAP/APQP, IATF 16949 for OEM supply, fixtures and gauges, rejection/rework %.

packs.label: Plastics & moulding
packs.hints: PLASTICS. Material grade and MFI, shot weight, runner/sprue weight (cold runner) vs hot runner, regrind % allowed, cycle time, cavitation, mould cost and life, start-up scrap, rejection. Plastic packaging EPR.

packs.label: Construction (temples, places of worship, public buildings)
packs.hints: CONSTRUCTION PROJECT, not a factory product: treat quantity as 1 project and ask about the structure itself. Ask: purpose and who it is for (trust, community, family), plot size and location, built-up area and capacity (people), style and tradition, structural system (load-bearing stone, RCC frame with stone cladding, or traditional), materials and finishes, services (power, lighting, sound, water, drainage, toilets, parking), approvals and timeline. TEMPLES: follow Agama / Shilpa Shastra and Vastu as the client wishes; styles Dravida (south: vimana and gopuram), Nagara (north: shikhara), Vesara; parts garbhagriha, antarala, ardha and maha mandapa, vimana or shikhara, gopuram, prakara wall, dhwaja stambha, kitchen (madapalli), temple tank. Materials: granite (Tamil Nadu, Karnataka), sandstone (Rajasthan), Makrana marble, RCC with lime or stucco work for gopurams; skilled sthapathis and stone carvers (Mamallapuram, Karaikudi, Rajasthan) — carving labour is a major cost line and stone dressing and carving waste is high; panchaloha or stone idols. Approvals: local body building permission, structural stability per NBC and IS codes, seismic zone and soil test, fire NOC for large halls, HR&CE or trust rules where applicable (e.g. Tamil Nadu), ASI rules near protected monuments. OTHER PLACES OF WORSHIP AND PUBLIC BUILDINGS: capacity, hall spans, acoustics, ventilation, fire exits, accessibility.

router._about: Routes a request to the engineered Building engine or the AI product engine. Building wins when a structure word is present; 'factory/plant/unit' alone is ambiguous (could mean the building or the product line), so both are offered.
